note: Eleven engine files F4-01…F4-09, F4-11, F4-12 plus F4-10 as a preset of F4-08 (no separate file, per master AL table). F4-05 is a preset of F5-11.
sharedRestrictions: Original neon/chalk apparatus retained; no redesign. Ready within each declared native numerical domain. Decimal numerals containing digit 4 stay caption-only (existing speech safeguard). Automated accessibility is not human screen-reader certification. Tested headless on Linux Google Chrome 154 via Playwright 1.62 (F0–F3 used Microsoft Edge on Windows). Lessons exported earlier embed source snapshots and must be regenerated.
